why: The observation FEATURE CROSS. Ten structured features are float(bool(channel)) and any([]) is False, so a 0 means both 'the page has none' and 'nothing looked'. Measured on the authoritative corpus: 61.7% of empty formChanges, 56.1% of empty postSubmitFields and 65.3% of the formControl sweep are the second, so a head can take a free negative weight on a CAPTURE CONDITION rather than a page fact -- ADR 0015's subject. Masking was refuted (not-working: it cost a real finding) and giving the model `observed` as its own column was declined (the shortcut risk), so this crosses the existing fact with whether it was measured: 'asked and present' and 'asked and absent' are two computed columns, and 'never asked' is the all-zeros row carrying no weight of its own. A ZERO CANNOT VETO, so the conjunction is computed rather than handed over as two features. Corrected the same day: the first version crossed `stateChanges` too, and NO capture carries `observed['stateChanges']` -- the disclosure probe is not gated on probeForms, so an empty channel there means one thing and the capture declines to record a question it never had to ask. Those two columns were constant zero, which is a dead column that looks like coverage. Crossed now: `formChanges` (61.7%) and `postSubmitFields` (56.1%), the two the measurement actually named, both with real `observed` entries. Opened 2026-09-03; closes when the retrain following the in-flight recapture stamps v19 into the weights. It is REVERTED, not merged, if any of four gates fails: scorer:shortcuts (closable vetoes must FALL and no head may gain one on a new column), rules:real-pages (zero new findings on the 86 conformant pages), held-out acceptance (must not regress), corpus:distribution (the new columns must not be constant). GATE 4 WAS NAMED WRONG AND IS CORRECTED: it said `corpus:distribution`, which checks whether an ARRAY FIELD is empty on every record — a computed feature is neither a field nor present in the export, so that gate is structurally blind to a constant column. It is now `scorer:shortcuts`' constant-column report, added 2026-09-03 where every feature is already computed over every record. A gate named for a fault it cannot express is worse than no gate.
closesWith: the retrain after the in-flight corpus recapture
revertIf: scorer:shortcuts — closable vetoes do not fall, or a head gains a veto on a new column
rules:real-pages — any new finding against the 86 conformant real pages
scorer:shortcuts' CONSTANT-COLUMN report — either new column reads one value across the whole corpus
notARefutation: A head with NO VALID CUT at 0.95, the top of the grid. Three heads sit there already — 3.3.1, 4.1.2:state-change-silent, 4.1.3 — and one more negative crossing 0.95 leaves them no clean threshold at all, whereupon the FALLBACK fires and 3.3.1's own sweep measures it at 31 false positives. That is a head going from clean to unusable on ONE record, and it is a property of choosing the threshold as an extreme order statistic, not of anything v19 changed.

A `development.precision` below 1.000. It is the zero-false-positive constraint restated with the cut chosen from those same out-of-fold scores, so 1.000 is guaranteed whenever calibration SUCCEEDS — and below 1.000 can only mean the fallback fired, i.e. the head has no clean cut anywhere.
howToTellThemApart: READ THE THRESHOLD SWEEP, which `threshold_sweep` already writes into the report as a whole curve, and which the blocker names. CLAUDE.md's rule decides it: at the next cut down, ONE false positive is a record to go and read; FORTY means the head is genuinely weak and the threshold is doing its job. A head that separates its positives cleanly one grid step lower has not regressed — the cut moved.
ungroundedAndNotToBeChangedHERE: Replacing the zero-false-positive criterion with a quantile or with conformal risk control is the principled fix and is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE for this migration. CLAUDE.md: it trades 'zero on this corpus' for 'bounded in expectation', which for a tool that ASSERTS conformance failures is a decision about what the product promises, not to be made silently. The library carries nothing on conformal prediction (requested 2026-09-03, ISBN 9780123985378), so it is also not a decision to make from memory.
